## Objective

Implement the hybrid Sys4AI project initializer and project-bound Memory System adoption while preserving independent repository ownership for Sys4AI and every child project.

User value: The Sys4AI Project Director can later create safe, governed projects with isolated memory through one canonical workflow while retaining a clear manual fallback and preserving every project's ownership.

### Success outcomes

- One reusable and one active init-new-project skill implement the bounded canonical route from exact template seed to verified project.
- The template remains a static uninitialized seed and supplies a correct local manual Memory System guide.
- The Memory Service supplies one direct, no-preview, fail-closed bootstrap and an immutable consumer wheel.
- The depot receives its own isolated Memory System with the approved tiered source registry and explicit later-source admission.
- End-to-end evidence proves identity, asset, registry, package, path, log, dataset, rerun, and cross-project isolation behavior without Git or publication.
- Independent repository identities are verified per project, Git metadata is never copied, and parent discovery cannot ingest child content regardless of registry membership.

## Scope

### In scope

- Extend the Memory Service with the common direct bootstrap, project-local path hardening, consumer resources, immutable wheel workflow, and tests.
- Create SKILLS-depo/init-new-project and adopt one reviewed active root copy.
- Use the exact template through an explicit clean-starter allowlist and add INIT_MEMORY.md plus its README link.
- Specialize new project identity, install exactly six baseline skills and the baseline soul, register factual inventory, install the exact wheel, initialize memory, and issue a bounded receipt.
- Create sys4ai-depot canonical memory configuration, protections, tiered source registry, reviewed later-source registration workflow, local runtime installation, derived state, discovery, synchronization, and validation.
- Verify canonical and manual routes, equivalent reruns, conflicts, destination boundaries, package immutability, user-wide log absence, and two-project isolation.
- Perform full forward and reverse traceability plus a final protected-path audit.
- Record and enforce separate root/child ownership, Git-root detection, per-repository verification and template Git-metadata exclusion; reconcile observed missing child repositories as an explicit prerequisite.

### Out of scope

- Initialize Memory System state, a provider database, model cache, or runtime log inside Projects/Sys4AI-Template-Project/.
- Use account-wide or user-wide Memory System or Cognee data, databases, caches, models, or logs.
- Generate a preview, preview digest, or preview-approval pause for a newly created or manually copied project.
- Create projects outside the registered Sys4AI Projects/ container in version 1.
- Restore automatic synchronization or propagate later reusable-source changes into existing projects.
- Use editable sibling-path dependencies or copied consumer-local Memory Service source.
- Initialize Git, configure remotes, commit, push, publish a package, configure GitHub Pages, deploy, or contact an external party.
- Enable shared production mode, cloud fallback, acquire credentials, or run non-fixture destructive operations.
- Execute any task in this plan merely because the plan exists or becomes structurally valid.
- Establish missing standalone repositories, move checkouts, convert to submodules, migrate history, or treat parent Git discovery as a child repository.

### Execution authority

This plan records and tracks proposed work. Creating, validating, or approving it does not authorize implementation, dependency installation, Memory System initialization, provider or model activation, destructive action, Git operation, publication, deployment, external communication, or another separately governed action.

### Constraints

- Treat the depot root, template, and Memory Service as separate project-owned artifact sets even though the root coordinates this plan.
- Preserve all unrelated dirty and untracked work; reread exact files and current digests before every later mutation.
- Use only Projects/Sys4AI-Template-Project/ as the seed and only destinations beneath the registered Sys4AI Projects/ directory in version 1.
- Keep the template uninitialized; exclude its environments, caches, operating-system metadata, bytecode, derived state, provider data, logs, receipts, and model artifacts from copied projects.
- Use the Memory Service provider-neutral API and hardened adapter; never import or access Cognee directly from an initializer or consumer.
- Store no credential value in Git, plans, Tasks, logs, fixtures, receipts, command arguments, memory, or generated output.
- Do not create or use user-wide Memory System, Cognee data, cache, database, model, or log paths.
- The no-preview rule applies to new-project and manual-template bootstrap; it does not waive internal preflight or unrelated destructive-operation preview controls.
- Build and install an immutable local wheel into each consumer's own environment; no editable sibling dependency, source copy, upload, or publication.
- Plan creation and Task tracking do not authorize implementation, installation, Memory System initialization, provider or model activation, Git operations, publication, deployment, or external communication.
- Sys4AI is the root project name; sys4ai-depot remains its stable memory identity. Each child is an independent ownership and repository unit, never a parent-owned module or inferred submodule.
- Resolve Q-001 before repository-dependent implementation. Preserve observed missing child Git markers; repository establishment and future-project Git provisioning are separate work unless the user expressly changes scope.
- Snapshot, test, inspect status and diff per actual repository. Also compare file manifests for child trees excluded from root tracking.
- Each planned task has one accountable execution owner selected and recorded by the Project Director before execution. No parallel_groups are assigned because product/bootstrap and registry dependencies share state.
- Root digest-bound adoption and new/manual-project direct bootstrap share validation and initialization logic; entry-specific authorization must not introduce previews into new-project paths.
- Stage starter content before derived-state creation: REQ-004 excludes template-derived .sys4ai/memory from the copy, while REQ-018 then creates fresh destination-local state after protections pass.
- DEC-018 authorizes execution in the current project-owned folders despite absent independent Git repositories. Record their Git metadata as unavailable; package/source manifests bind provenance. Git setup remains separate and cannot block non-Git implementation.
